headline: BRIXTON HITS 5,015 G/T SILVER OVER 20m — New Brownfields Zone in Cobalt Camp; Sub-Interval Hits 89,125 G/T (TSXV: BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corporation (TSXV: BBB) drilled 20 metres averaging 5,015 g/t silver in a new brownfields discovery area called Shaft 6 Southeast (S6-SE) at its Langis Silver Project in the historic Cobalt, Ontario silver camp — including a 14-metre sub-interval at 7,150 g/t and extraordinary narrow veins assaying 74,137 g/t and 89,125 g/t that reflect the native-silver vein texture characteristic of the original Cobalt bonanza finds. Hole 377 is located 140 metres east of the previous Shaft 6 South discovery hole (11.35m @ 4,560 g/t), confirming the S6-SE area as a separately mineralised system within the company's 2026 campaign, which has now completed 105 holes totalling 24,016 metres and keeps delivering grade surprises in areas the historic miners never systematically drilled.

headline: BARRICK BETS C$20.9M ON BC PORPHYRY — Takes 9.9% of Kingfisher, Veto on Highway 37 Sale; KFR Jumps 23% (TSXV: KFR)
snippet: Barrick Mining Corporation (NYSE: GOLD / TSX: ABX) has agreed to subscribe for 15,470,934 units of Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSXV: KFR) at C$1.35 per unit — total consideration C$20.9 million — giving Barrick a 9.9% non-diluted (14.1% partially diluted) stake in Kingfisher's Highway 37 Copper-Gold Porphyry District in northwest British Columbia, home to the Hank porphyry Cu-Au system now under active two-rig drilling. Under an Investor Rights Agreement closing around July 27, Barrick earns anti-dilution rights, information access, a two-year consent right over any sale of the Highway 37 Project, and technical support for Kingfisher's 2027-2028 drill campaigns — a structural arrangement that protects Barrick's optionality on one of BC's most prospective post-Casino porphyry belts while leaving Kingfisher fully in operational control; KFR jumped approximately 23% on the announcement.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,000 FLOOR; SILVER RETRACES FROM $59 HIGH — July 29 FOMC in Focus as Rate Hike Odds Collapse to 16.6%
snippet: Gold settled near-unchanged at US$4,008/oz on Tuesday — holding the $4,000 floor through a session that saw silver surge to $59.47 intraday on Iran ceasefire diplomacy before retracing to $56.36 at the close, with both metals validating support levels that held through both the month's Iran war premium and today's de-escalation unwind. CME FedWatch now shows just a 16.6% probability of a July rate hike, down sharply from last week's 80% December-hike odds — with next Wednesday's FOMC minutes release and the July 29 policy decision the two key near-term catalysts for whether gold reclaims $4,100 or tests $3,900.

headline: CABRAL GOLD MG INFILL DONE — Q4 Commercial Gold Production Target; Heap Leach Now Commissioning in Brazil (TSXV: CBR)
snippet: Cabral Gold Inc. (TSXV: CBR) has completed its 165-hole, 5,767-metre reverse-circulation infill program at the MG Gold Deposit in the Cuiú Cuiú Gold District of Pará State, Brazil — targeting upgrade of the gold-in-oxide MG starter pit resource from indicated to measured classification in support of the company's Phase 1 heap leach operation now in active commissioning. With commercial gold production targeted for Q4 2026, the program's completion removes the final pre-production drilling variable ahead of Cabral's first gold pour from one of Brazil's most advanced oxide gold projects.

headline: OREZONE CASA BERARDI RESUMES AFTER WILDFIRE — Quebec Pause Converted to Advance Maintenance; Annual Guidance Intact
snippet: Orezone Gold Corporation announced that its Casa Berardi mine in northwestern Quebec resumed full operations on the evening of July 17 following a voluntary three-day suspension triggered by wildfire activity approximately 12 kilometres from site — with a skeleton crew using the pause to complete planned maintenance originally scheduled for later in 2026, reducing future downtime. The company reaffirmed 2026 guidance of 62,000–67,000 ounces from Casa Berardi, effectively absorbing the disruption without any impact on annual output targets.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER PALMER VMS HITS MASSIVE SULPHIDE IN SOUTH WALL ZONE — Assays Pending on 5 Alaska Holes (TSXV: VCU)
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU) reported that the first five diamond drill holes of its fully funded 10,000-metre 2026 program at the Palmer Copper-Zinc VMS Project in southeast Alaska have intersected thick intervals of semi-massive and massive sulphide mineralisation in both Zone 1 and Zone 2 of the South Wall Zone — with two rigs now operating and assay results pending from the initial holes. The Palmer VMS system is one of the highest-grade undeveloped copper-zinc deposits in North America, and this first field-season update confirms the program is on schedule in a jurisdiction that has historically produced several world-class VMS mines.
